turns.prompt: Fit the nonlinear model y = (b1 + b2*x + b3*x**2) / (1 + b4*x + b5*x**2) to the data in kirby2.csv (columns x, y) by least squares, starting from b1 = 2, b2 = -0.1, b3 = 0.003, b4 = -0.001, b5 = 0.00001. Report every parameter (b1, b2, b3, b4, b5) to at least 6 significant digits and the residual sum of squares as rss.

provenance: NIST StRD Kirby2 (public domain), data copied verbatim
